subject.title: acp: assistant text corrupted when Gateway revises in-progress output (non-append revision mis-sliced)

question: How should the ACP bridge represent Gateway replace=true revisions when ACP message chunks are append-oriented and cannot retract already-emitted text?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but choosing between buffering, a new message/messageId strategy, metadata/capability extensions, or accepting duplicate visible text changes client-visible protocol behavior.

options.title: Require an ACP-compatible replacement mapping
options.body: Revise the fix so replacement deltas cannot leave stale visible text in standard ACP clients, with text and thinking regression tests plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Use a client-specific extension
options.body: Allow replace metadata or capability-specific behavior only if maintainers accept and document fallback behavior for clients that ignore it.

options.title: Accept duplicate/new-message fallback
options.body: Land a simpler reset-and-emit behavior knowingly, accepting that some clients may show stale and corrected text for one turn.

recommendation.title: Require an ACP-compatible replacement mapping
recommendation.body: Revise the fix so replacement deltas cannot leave stale visible text in standard ACP clients, with text and thinking regression tests plus real behavior proof.
